cover.headline_html: 3 myths that stop GSA applicants cold.

myths.label: The Past-Performance Trap
myths.myth_text: You need federal past performance before GSA will even consider you.
myths.reality_text: GSA applications run on commercial past performance — 3 years of private-sector sales. No federal history needed. The Schedule is often your first step into federal, not a reward for already being there.

myths.label: The Big-Company Myth
myths.myth_text: The GSA Schedule is built for large primes — not small businesses.
myths.reality_text: The majority of 20,000+ active GSA Schedule holders are small businesses. The contract was designed to level the playing field — not to reserve it for primes who already dominate it.

myths.label: The Set-It-and-Forget-It Fantasy
myths.myth_text: Once you're on the Schedule, agencies will search you out and call.
myths.reality_text: The Schedule is a hunting license, not a sales team. You still need to market, respond to RFQs, and build relationships with contracting officers. The Schedule opens the door — you walk through it.

close.close_question: Drop the myth you believed before you started — or the one you still hear from other small business owners.
